description: Type the 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT release create/patch return when the blueprint package image cannot be read from Artifact Registry ("invalid argument reader.DigestBasedURI() failed to read for img path: ... NAME_UNKNOWN"). It surfaced as a generic BadRequest.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The release's blueprint package image does not exist or is not readable (HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT: "... failed to read for img path: ..."). Push the blueprint image first.
